package.name: nros_runner_west
package.description:
The `west` runner (RFC-0119 D8). Runs a Zephyr image on the emulator its west build declares (`west build -t run_<emulator>`), and flashes a real board through Zephyr's own flash runner (`west flash`, the board's default from the build's `runners.yaml` unless `--runner` names another).
A runner package of the same shape as a user's: the announcement below is what the provider scan reads, `nros-runner.toml` is read only when this provider is the one selected, and the executable speaks RFC-0119 D6.
